column1: # Per-file first blocker for the 235 still-coded files of the whole-tree
#   find /tmp/src-base/src -name "*.rs" | xargs -P6 -n1 <run rust-frontend --shir F; record rc + first stderr line>
# columns: file<TAB>line<TAB>first-blocker   (line = the refusing source line)
# THE WALLS this tree still hits (v0.39 closed the nested-item / call-operand
# classes; every remaining refused file blocks on one of these):
#    module/symbol RESOLVER, not a lowering rule (the frontend sees one file).
#    imported RenderCtx/Pipe/MapLiteral has no field table (same resolver).
#  * `*slot = v` / `*tmp += 1` on a FIELD, or through a `&mut` under
#    another name, or a whole-value write through a `&mut` collection —
#    v0.40 writes only a PLAIN scalar slot whose name the caller passes
#    through, so these still need a real reference layer.
#  * a deep-equality RUNTIME MEMBER (`words == ["-L"]`, slice == array
#    literal); no such sh2.* member exists, so it is refused, not invented.
#    on non-integers — semantics sh2perl does not define.
